key_insight: The paper introduces robust multigrid preconditioners for unfitted finite element discretisations of the de Rham complex, using aggregation-aware smoothers and auxiliary-space coupling to handle cut-cell stabilisation.
engineering_relevance: These preconditioners improve solver robustness for H(grad), H(curl), and H(div) problems on complex geometries without requiring body-fitted meshes, which is valuable for scalable multiphysics and mixed finite element simulations.
method: Geometric multigrid directly on unfitted operators over a shared background-mesh hierarchy.
Star-patch smoothers on the aggregated mesh to capture stabilisation kernels.
Auxiliary-space preconditioner combining cut-cell patch smoothing with a body-fitted active-mesh solve via non-nested geometric multigrid.
evidence_signal: Numerical tests in 2D and 3D report iteration counts that remain robust with respect to cut configuration, mesh size, and number of levels, including higher-order and weak-Dirichlet variants.
watch_item: Performance and implementation depend on reliable aggregation/cut-cell handling, so complex geometries and face-based stabilisation may increase setup complexity.
paper_title: Geometric multigrid preconditioners for unfitted discretisations of the de Rham complex
